content: {"praised":["Strong cast with Hayley Mills delivering a standout performance.","Simple, effective script that keeps the story engaging.","Family‑oriented production values create a warm, wholesome tone.","Charming depiction of early 20th‑century rural life.","Pleasant, clean music enhances the overall experience."],"criticized":["Story feels corny and overly sentimental.","Plot unrealistic; everything resolves too neatly.","Characters exhibit cheesy, stereotypical traits.","Hayley Mills’ British accent clashes with family.","DVD damaged, parts missing during playback."]}
